gates.notes: Candidate contracts are documented and tested; the final freeze belongs to the 1.0 release commit.
A complete undisturbed real-window multi-operation run is still required.
Trusted install, launch, association, upgrade, repair and uninstall evidence is required.
The signed candidate must run on physical ARM64 Windows hardware.
Narrator, keyboard, IME, high contrast and DPI gates must select the shipping UI.
Four signed-candidate screenshots per locale must replace the draft manifest.
Signed x64 and ARM64 candidates require formal WACK reports.
Partner Center submission and Microsoft certification must complete.
The versioned manifest must be accepted by microsoft/winget-pkgs.
ZiFile name reservation and the assigned package identity are required.
The ADR-0006 cloud-HSM path must replace PFX release scaffolding.
